during-in-a-league-world.npc: Hello! Do you have any questions for me?

options.text: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.player: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.npc: All sorts of things! I can't recount all of the information for you, but I can give you the basics though.
During this League, you are initially restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!
Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?

steps.text: Trailblazer Info interface opens.

steps.npc: Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.
Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.
League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.text: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.npc: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.
Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?

steps.text: Trailblazer Task interface opens.

options.text: How does the area system work?

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.npc: In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?

steps.text: Trailblazer Task interface opens.

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.npc: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?

steps.text: Trailblazer Relic interface opens.

steps.npc: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.npc: One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.npc: At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?

steps.player: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.npc: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?

options.text: Do I have any League items to collect?

steps.text: You receive some items from the Leagues Tutor.

during-in-a-non-league-world.npc: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?

steps.npc: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.

steps.player: A fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.npc: Glory, gold, and the chance to do things in a different way!
First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
The more points you have at the end of the League, the better League Rank you will be given.
Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!

steps.player: And if glory and gold don't interest me?

steps.npc: Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the world you're used to.
Not only that, but within this League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Fragments. Fragments completely change the way you progress through the League!
So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

steps.text: If the player is a free-to-play player:

steps.player: I see. So how do I take part?

steps.npc: Well sadly you're not eligible to take part in a League right now. I'll be happy to help once you are though.

steps.text: If the player is a member:

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.npc: My pleasure!

options.text: Is there currently a League running?
Can I purchase some League rewards?
Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.npc: All the best.

options.text: Is there currently a League running?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: Yes! The current League is Leagues III - Shattered Relics.
Within this League you are restricted to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, you can unlock more skills by completing tasks to earn Sage's Renown.
Sage's Renown can be used to purchase access to Skills, Bosses and to Auto Complete Quests.
You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Fragments, each Fragment provides a different buff so be sure to collect them all.
You can level up these Fragments to make them even stronger, you can also bring together different Fragments to activate powerful buffs known as Set Effects.
I heard there's one that lets you swap between Magic spellbooks whenever you want!
Not only that, but you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part.

steps.npc: I'd highly recommend it.

steps.text: To take part in a League, you must be on a Leagues World. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

options.text: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.player: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.npc: Certainly! I have a number of unique rewards which you might be interested in.

steps.text: If the Leagues Reward Shop is closed (between 28 October 2020 – 15 December 2020)
The Leagues Reward Shop is temporarily closed.

options.text: Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.player: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.npc: Of course! What would you like to know?
League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.

options.text: I'd like to claim some League Trophies.

steps.player: I'd like to claim some League Trophies.

steps.npc: Of course!

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You have not earned any League trophies. If you want a League trophy you should participate next time a League comes around!

steps.text: If the player has earned points during the Twisted League:
You receive a League trophy from the Leagues Tutor.
If the player does not have enough inventory space:

steps.npc: You do not have enough space for all the League Trophies available to you. Come back to me when you do.

steps.text: If the player has claimed all eligible trophies:

steps.npc: Ah! Looks like you have already claimed all of the League Trophies available to you.

options.text: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?

steps.player: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?

steps.npc: Which League do you want to know about?
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 10 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 80 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 510 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 1,770 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 5,270 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 10,820 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 20,830 points.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned 0 League points which does not qualify you for any trophy.

steps.text: If the player has earned more than 10 points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues I - Twisted. That makes you eligible for the Twisted [type] Trophy and all Twisted Trophies under it!
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 510 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 2,000 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 6,480 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 18,720 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 35,680 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 56,310 points.
You earned [number] League Points in Leagues II - Trailblazer. That makes you eligible for the Trailblazer [type] Trophy and all Trailblazer Trophies under it!

options.text: Actually, let's talk about something else.
Actually, let's talk about something else.

steps.player: Actually, let's talk about something else.

steps.npc: Very well.
All the best.
